capabilities.text: Choose a class 1, 2 or 3 lever (fulcrum, load or effort in the middle)
Set the effort arm and the load arm, drawn to scale
capabilities.note: Ours clamps very unequal arms and says “Arm lengths are schematized for legibility.”

capabilities.text: Measure the arms in cm, m, in or ft
Set the load as a force in N or lb
Give the load as a mass in kg or g
Draw the load as a block on the beam or as a force arrow
Work out the effort from the load and the arms, to 3 significant figures
capabilities.note: Ours writes the effort value only with Show answers on; the student copy has a blank line there.

capabilities.text: Label the load and each arm with its value
capabilities.note: The value labels are the opening state; the tokens show they follow the values.

capabilities.text: Write your own text, such as F_E or ?, in the load, effort or arm labels
Put a blank line in the load, effort or arm labels for students
Leave the load, effort or arm labels off
Name the effort, load and fulcrum
capabilities.note: Names are written at the opening state.

capabilities.text: Put a blank line in place of a name for students to label
Leave a name off
Turn the two arms’ dimension lines on or off
Write a chart title
Print an answer key with the mechanical advantage under the figure
Set the label size
Mirror the lever left to right
Color the figure for slides
